completionRule: Coverage is complete only when required checks pass or the maintainer explicitly waives them with evidence.

coverage.requirement: Protect user work, preserve dirty worktrees, and keep changes reversible.
coverage.gap: Requires current diff review before every commit.

coverage.requirement: Prevent secrets exposure and govern SSH hardening risk.
coverage.gap: Track mode-isolation, lockout-safety, and fail-fast validation until direct-cloud SSH is proven.

coverage.requirement: Keep governance and implementation surfaces mapped to a single operating contract.
Make governance evidence reproducible through generated reports.
coverage.gap: Reports must be regenerated after source JSON changes.

coverage.requirement: Preserve Apple-first platform direction while keeping cross-platform checks realistic.
Treat design, accessibility, and product experience as engineering systems.
Keep AI, data, cloud, SSH, and automation work governed and measurable.
coverage.gap: Direct cloud mobile SSH remains blocked until strict readiness passes.

coverage.requirement: Track the requested SEIS AI 150B direction as an evidence-gated frontier research lane without claiming trained weights, routeable inference, provider access, SSH execution, or production readiness.
coverage.gap: 150B remains blocked until 20B and 70B evidence, clean-room training plan, distributed runtime budget, privacy and safety review, observability, rollback, and explicit human approval exist; no trained or routeable 150B SEIS model claim exists.

coverage.requirement: Keep GitHub, community, governance, and CI readiness visible.
coverage.gap: External GitHub branch settings must be verified before claiming enforcement.

coverage.requirement: Treat God Mode as incomplete unless Dashboard, Goals, Repos, Docs, Agents, security, AI policy, rollback, validation, and handoff all receive explicit feature or governance improvement evidence.
coverage.gap: Commit, push, CI, and final staged-boundary evidence are still required before the broad God Mode objective can be marked complete.
